# Test issuegraph dep error cases

issuegraph init --prefix test

issuegraph create 'First issue'
cp stdout first.txt
exec sh -c 'grep -oE "test-[a-z0-9]+" first.txt > first_id.txt'

# Add dependency with nonexistent blocker should fail
! exec sh -c 'issuegraph dep add $(cat first_id.txt) nonexistent-id'
stderr 'no issue found'

# Add self-dependency should fail
! exec sh -c 'issuegraph dep add $(cat first_id.txt) $(cat first_id.txt)'
stderr 'cannot depend on itself'

# dep tree on nonexistent issue should fail
! issuegraph dep tree nonexistent-id
stderr 'no issue found'
